records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and six months ended June 30, 2023, we generated $231.0 million and $452.0 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended June 30, 2023 was: cloud subscriptions 26%; software license 2%; maintenance 16%; services 54%; and hardware 2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the six months ended June 30, 2023 was: cloud subscriptions 26%; software license 2%; maintenance 16%; services 53%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $31.6 million and $62.4 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2023, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $40.6 million and $99.3 million, respectively.
